label: C / FACE Case 5
paper-case: FACE Case 5 (500 mm^2 compute die, 4 HBM2E chiplets)

paper-64gib.label: 64 GiB paper configuration
paper-64gib.note: FACE Case 5 provides 64 GiB of local HBM per NPU in the paper configuration.

validation-160gib.label: 160 GiB validation extension
validation-160gib.note: Validation-only capacity extension for workloads that require 160 GiB of local HBM per NPU.

notes: The physical mesh is row-major with 9 rows and 6 columns.
The analytical network lists dimensions as columns then rows.
Peak compute is an explicit WSC-LLM comparison-group-C fallback because the FACE Case 5 peak is unpublished.
D2D latency is modeled as a per-hop adjacent-link latency.
The remote-memory pool is attached to every physical mesh-boundary NPU.
The 512 GB/s remote-memory bandwidth and 100 ns latency are shared simulator assumptions.
The capacity profile describes local HBM placement per NPU.
